list_machinery.sql: SELECT name as machine_name, make, status FROM turf_machines

list_consumables.sql: SELECT description, ac_unit, current_balance FROM (SELECT i.id, i.description, i.ac_unit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.transaction_type = 'RECEIPT' THEN l.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.transaction_type = 'ISSUE' THEN l.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id WHERE m.fuel_item_id = i.id), 0) AS current_balance FROM turf_inventory_items i LEFT JOIN turf_inventory_ledger l ON i.id = l.item_id GROUP BY i.id, i.description, i.ac_unit) as balances

list_turf_consumption_log.sql: SELECT tcl.log_date, tm.name as machine_name, tcl.recorded_by as operator, tcl.fuel_consumed_qty, tcl.running_hours FROM turf_consumption_log tcl JOIN turf_machines tm ON tcl.machine_id = tm.id

report_monthly_consumption.sql: SELECT m.name as machine_name, SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) as total_fuel_consumed FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id

report_consumption_trend.sql: SELECT to_char(c.log_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) as total_consumed FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id JOIN turf_inventory_items i ON m.fuel_item_id = i.id
report_consumption_trend.group_by: GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

list_with_ordering.sql: SELECT tcl.log_date, tm.name as machine_name, tcl.recorded_by as operator, tcl.fuel_consumed_qty, tcl.running_hours FROM turf_consumption_log tcl JOIN turf_machines tm ON tcl.machine_id = tm.id

report_historical_balance.sql: SELECT i.description, i.ac_unit, (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.transaction_type = 'RECEIPT' THEN l.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.transaction_type = 'ISSUE' THEN l.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id WHERE m.fuel_item_id = i.id AND c.log_date <= :date_param), 0)) as balance_on_date FROM turf_inventory_items i LEFT JOIN turf_inventory_ledger l ON i.id = l.item_id AND l.transaction_date <= :date_param
